_doc: make (STR2RTS): the SDF task graphs of the STR2RTS suite in the application format of the flow (apps/str2rts, make convert STR2RTS=<checkout>) and the analysis flow on each of them (rttools/paper/str2rts.py; the module docstring states the rules). Paths of the applications relative to the STR2RTS checkout.

source._doc: STR2RTS: B. Rouxel and I. Puaut, STR2RTS: Refactored StreamIT benchmarks into statically analysable parallel benchmarks for WCET estimation and real-time scheduling, WCET 2017 (OASIcs 57). Licence of the suite: GNU GPL v3 (licence.txt of the checkout). The converter reads the XML descriptions only; sha256 of each XML in apps.

payload._doc: bytes of an edge = ceil(data-sent x bits of its data type / 8); bits: the <data-type name size> rows of the XML (every XML of the list declares int = 64 b and complex = 100 b), otherwise default_bits; floor_bytes: payload of an edge that comes out below it (edges without data: void, or data-sent 0); max_bytes: largest payload of one packet (uint16_t payload_size of noc_packet_t after the kernel rounds the payload up to a multiple of 4: 65,532; MAX_PAYLOAD of rttools/ucxgen/model.py), an edge above it is cut to max_bytes.

mesh._doc: 4x4 with at least min_tasks_4x4 tasks, otherwise 2x2; arch: file of arch/

scale._doc: c(v) = round(k WCET) + scheduler_cycles; budget B(T) = reference_hz x T cycles; T: the first multiple of period_step_s at which scheduler_cycles x (tasks of the cluster with the most tasks) <= scheduler_share x B(T) with the clustering of k(T); k(T): the largest factor with factor_decimals decimals whose largest cluster cost is at most B(T) (f_CPU <= reference_hz), by bisection with the clustering of the flow in the loop and `probes` factors above the result.

analysis._doc: f0_hz: first frequency of the search (as experiments/car-v and experiments/tt). handlers: inject and receive of the handler charge of Eq. (7), the handler terms of the image of CAR (send_isr and receive_isr_size + receive_isr_end of ../wcet/reference_tt.json, ni_images.car_full_gcc12.kernel, the terms that experiments/automotive uses; the largest of the stored images); budget B_v = 0 (the costs of the conversion hold no handler cycles). settings: flow (the model of the flow) and the removals that tell which term sets the clock (rttools/paper/str2rts.py, SETTINGS). timeout_s: an application that runs longer is stopped and reported.
